verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider with case status dashboards and People Ops integration. A buyer could fairly ask for case-event webhooks, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404, and the People Ops and dashboard claims are adjacent features, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
